title.narrative: PSC GPE STG Programme Development Grant

description.narrative: Bangladesh is now preparing to apply for the Global Partnership for Education (GPE) System Transformation Grant (STG)—an allocation of up to USD 48.85 million—to support identified priority reforms focused on teacher professionalization. The Government of Bangladesh, through the Ministry of Primary and Mass Education (MoPME), as Chair of the Education Local Consultative Group (ELCG), endorsed UNICEF and UNESCO’s joint Expression of Interest (EoI) to become joint Grant Agents (GA) for the GPE’s STG. This Programme Development Grant will support the development of a comprehensive application for the STG.
